name: Nilpotent-free subspaces of M_3(F_3): exact maximum 5
target: Wigderson Conjecture 8: dimension n^2-binomial(n,2) over every finite field
result: For F=F_3 and n=3 the exact maximum is 5, whereas the conjecture asks for 6. The upper bound uses an exhaustive 3,109,888-node cover; the lower bound has a direct algebraic proof.

notes.proof: Written reduction to all 3^18 coefficient matrices, a complete finite search, and an algebraic proof of the five-dimensional construction.
notes.formal: Archived Lean proof is computer-assisted and uses native_decide twice; this does not satisfy the engine standard-axioms-only kernel gate. This factor remains 0.
notes.code: anaxia construct nilpotent-free --full recompiles and executes the independent C verifier; the default command verifies only the lower bound.
notes.trace: Independent exact C checker matches all depth counts; separate enumeration checks all 25,095,280 five-dimensional subspaces of sl_3(F_3).
notes.sim: Finite exhaustive checks, with no floating-point or sampling input to the upper bound.
notes.risk: No conclusion about other matrix sizes or fields; Gerstenhaber-Serezhkin is unaffected.
notes.lit: Conjecture statement checked against arXiv:2609.29177v1, Conjecture 8; priority is subject to normal scholarly review.
notes.human: No referee certification supplied; the journal revision is prepared for author review.
